displayName: Disable or Modify Tools: Modify or Spoof Tool UI

tests.name: T1685.003 - Suppress Action Center and Security Notifications via Registry Modification

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify TrayNotify Icon Streams to Simulate Taskbar Icon Spoofing
tests.description: Simulates an adversary tampering with user tray icon stream registry values to hide or manipulate security tool icons in the taskbar.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Disable Security Center Notifications via WSC Registry Modification
tests.description: Simulates adversary tampering with Action Center settings to disable security alerts and falsify operational status reporting.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify Explorer Taskbar Tray Notification Policy Flags
tests.description: Simulates adversary modification of explorer taskbar settings to alter icon visibility and override notification states.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Tamper with Security Center Client Notification Level Registry
tests.description: Simulates adversary configuration changes to Security Center alert thresholds to suppress warning dialogs.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify Windows Defender Notification Settings via Registry
tests.description: Simulates adversary modification of Windows Defender UI notification behavior to suppress threat detection popups.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Clear PastIconsStream in TrayNotify to Simulate Tray Icon Erasure
tests.description: Simulates an adversary clearing historical tray icon mapping data to blind user visibility of security tool icons.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify Action Center Quick Action Settings to Remove Security Tiles
tests.description: Simulates adversary tampering with Action Center quick action configuration to hide security management shortcuts.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify Security Health UI Configuration Registry Keys
tests.description: Simulates adversary modification of SecHealthUI behavior settings to disrupt status reporting pipelines.

tests.name: T1685.003 - Modify Security Center CheckInterval to Desynchronize UI Updates
tests.description: Simulates adversary manipulation of Security Center status polling frequency to delay or freeze UI status updates.
